name: Waterfall
description: A waterfall of 250 kHz to 2 MHz (a chooser, up to the board's top rate: 2 MS/s on the WHY2025 badge, 500 kS/s on the S3), or of 40 or 80 MHz: without a gap where the radio streams it (the WHY2025 badge: the bursts its channelizer finds, each at its channel, over quiet noise), else from bursts; its controls tune it and set the radio's gain (or leave it to AGC), the FFT size and the lower and upper levels of the colour scale (at 40 and 80 MHz the lower 25 dB higher, the upper 40 dB higher).
author: esp-sdr
